'''Jonus''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] [[captain]] in [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)|Scimitar Squadron]], a [[squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy]]'s [[Imperial Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY]], Jonus was present aboard the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] when it was attacked by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Battle of Endor]].

As [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] personnel began to evacuate, Jonus ran through the corridors of the [[Death Star]] with [[Major]] [[Rhymer]], passing the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and Skywalker's [[Parent|father]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] shortly before the Death Star was destroyed.

==Biography==
[[File:Jonus-DSII.png|thumb|left|250px|Jonus ran through the corridors of the Death Star II during the Battle of Endor.]]
Jonus was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] [[captain]] in the [[Imperial Officer Corps]] and [[Imperial Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He flew as part of [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)|Scimitar Squadron]], a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bomber]] [[squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Starfighter Missions" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Jonus was on board the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]] in the [[Endor system]] during the [[Battle of Endor]], in which the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] launched an attack to destroy the [[Death Star]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

After the rebels had managed to successfully disable the superweapon's [[Deflector shield|shields]] and gained the upper hand in the battle, alarms began blaring on the Death Star as personnel raced to evacuate. Alongside fellow Scythe Squad [[pilot]] [[Major]] [[Rhymer]], Jonus ran through the corridors of the Death Star and passed by the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]] as the [[Jedi]] dragged his wounded [[Parent|father]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], toward one of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] parked nearby. Skywalker then had [[time]] to escape from the Death Star before it was completely destroyed by the Alliance.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Personality and traits==
Jonus had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="Starfighter Missions" />

==Equipment==
Jonus wore a black TIE pilot's [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]] while onboard the Death Star.<ref name="Episode VI" /> He flew an unmarked TIE/sa bomber.<ref name="Starfighter Missions" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jonus was created for the [[1983]] original trilogy film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Jonus was first identified in the [[2020]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]''.<ref name="Starfighter Missions" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' set released in [[2000]] for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Jonus}}</ref>
